en.headline: Man found dead in Tuen Mun drainage facility near Siu Hong
en.dek: Rescuers recovered a man from a low-flow interception system on Siu Hong Road after drainage staff raised the alarm; he was certified dead at the scene.
body: A man was found dead inside a drainage facility near Siu Hong in Tuen Mun on Monday afternoon after drainage staff reported discovering a person trapped in the system.
Police said the report was received at about 2.33 pm. Rescuers located the man at the intake grille of a low-flow interception system and brought him out. He was certified dead at the scene.
Officers sealed off the area for investigation. The identity of the deceased and the cause of death have not been established. A post-mortem examination will be conducted.

Local media reported that the man’s body appeared rigid when recovered, with arms raised and legs bent, but police have not commented on the circumstances beyond confirming the discovery and ongoing inquiries.

zh.headline: 屯門兆康路渠務設施發現男子遺體
zh.dek: 渠務人員下午發現低流量截流系統內有人被困，救援人員救出男子後證實死亡，警方封鎖現場調查。
body: 周一下午，屯門兆康路一帶渠務設施內發現一名男子死亡。渠務人員約下午2時33分報案，指低流量截流系統內懷疑有人被困。
救援人員趕到後，在入水口格柵位置將男子救起，惟當場證實已經死亡。警方封鎖現場調查，並對遺體進行拍照取證。
警方表示，死者身份及死因暫時未明，有待法醫解剖確定。案件交由屯門警區跟進。
現場消息指，男子獲救時身體已經僵硬，雙手向上舉起、雙腳屈曲，但警方未有進一步評論事發經過。
